I10 note: the sibling Oracle NetSuite ↔ Workato edge (recu1XqfeDUoDSbvm) created in the same pass records the GENERIC Workato NetSuite connector. integrations.name: Amazon Redshift (via Forma Construction Connect)
integrations.description: Autodesk's Forma Construction Connect (formerly ACC Connect), an Autodesk-productised Workato tenant, moves Autodesk Forma project data into a customer's Amazon Redshift warehouse on customer-built recipes. Autodesk's own blog describes it as synchronising files and data into Amazon S3 and Redshift, so the flow runs Autodesk Forma to Redshift. What moves is whatever the customer's recipe selects; Autodesk names no specific records.
integrations.notes:
Discovered via Autodesk AECO Partner Ecosystem on 2026-05-07. Forma Construction Connect powered by Workato.

RE-AUDITED 2026-09-08 by a top-to-bottom run on Amazon Redshift. www.autodesk.com 403s both curl and WebFetch, so the listing was read in a browser. Four things were established and two were left open.

ESTABLISHED — the listing is live and is about this pair (I5). Title "Amazon Redshift (Powered by Forma Construction Connect) | Autodesk AECO Technology Partner Ecosystem". Category "Data & Analytics", region Americas, support by Autodesk. Its Details section reads, in full: "Use Workato to sync data between Redshift & Autodesk Forma" and "Build custom recipes based on connector triggers".

ESTABLISHED — direction, which was previously unset (I7). Autodesk's own blog, "Autodesk and AWS are Helping Construction Firms Gain Useful Insights from Their Data", says customers "use Autodesk Construction Cloud Connect (ACC Connect) to synchronize files and data INTO Amazon S3 and Redshift" and again "use ACC Connect to SEND DATA TO Amazon S3, Amazon Redshift, or other Amazon data stores". Both phrasings are one-way into the warehouse, which beats the listing's own symmetric "sync data between". Set to one-way. Note the listing's phrasing is the weaker evidence and is recorded here so a later pass can see the call was made rather than missed.

ESTABLISHED — the mechanism is generic (I15), and this row sits on the qualifying side only because the counterpart is separately listed with its own directory page. Forma Construction Connect is a recipe builder, so the same capability reaches every system Workato carries. Autodesk publishes a per-partner directory page for each, which is what makes each one a pair rather than one capability with names attached. Twenty-two rows in the catalogue share this mechanism_name, so they are one Autodesk decision read twenty-two times (I8), not twenty-two independent findings.

ESTABLISHED — NO BUSINESS OBJECT IS NAMED ANYWHERE. Not on the directory listing, which names none, and not in the blog, which describes what moves as "files and data", "critical project data and files", and the AEC data types generally (documents, photos, videos, CAD files, BIM models, spatial data). The blog DOES contain the words Issues, RFIs and Submittals, and they are a trap: that sentence is about embedding an Amazon QuickSight Partner Card in Autodesk Build's Insight Dashboard "alongside the critical construction workflows you already monitor in Autodesk Build or BIM 360". Those are workflows watched inside Autodesk, not records crossing into Redshift. See the claim note on recVrnVUjDxHJNGuE.

LEFT OPEN 1 — RESOLVED 2026-09-15 BY AECI-809. The question was which Autodesk record this edge belongs on: the live listing says the counterpart is "Autodesk Forma" while the row pointed at Autodesk Construction Cloud, and re-pointing one row would have made it inconsistent with 83 siblings. The catalogue-wide answer has now been taken — Autodesk Construction Cloud merged into Autodesk Forma (rec2KtJeJUzqih3ad) and the ACC record retires — so this row and its 79 siblings moved together. Autodesk's directory was right and the catalogue was a rebrand behind.

LEFT OPEN 2 — STILL OPEN. This row points powered_by at Workato. The listing says "Powered by Forma Construction Connect", and the catalogue holds Forma Construction Connect (formerly ACC Connect) as a connector product (recwU2Nyq7xxLXyiv). Of the 22 rows carrying this mechanism_name, 18 point at Workato and 3 at Forma Construction Connect, so the class is already inconsistent. Not changed here, because picking a side is a sweep across 22 rows rather than a fix to one.

Also recorded: the older dedicated page, construction.autodesk.com/workflows/construction-software-integrations/amazon-redshift/, now 301s to www.autodesk.com/integrations. The same happened to the Snowflake equivalent, except that Snowflake has been dropped from the live directory and Redshift is still in it.
